author: MOLLINO
quote: GTA 6 is completely cooked. Rockstar used to make games about crime, chaos, and actual satire. Now they’re just making a DEI checklist with guns.They force this Lucia character down our throats — some Latina chick who’s clearly designed to check every progressive box. She’s written like a walking diversity pamphlet instead of an actual criminal. Every scene with her feels like the writers are more worried about not “objectifying” her than about making her interesting or ****’s got that smug, self-important energy where the game treats her like some complex, empowered figure while she just comes off as annoying and forced. The writing bends over backwards to make sure she never looks weak or wrong, which just makes her feel fake as hell. Classic modern game ****: better to have a boring, politically correct symbol than a real character people actually want to play.Lucia is pure DEI filler. Forced, unlikable, and a clear sign Rockstar cares more about virtue-signaling than making a good **** game.
